versions.content: The ECU Manager module shall only invoke wakeup validation on those wakeup sources where it is required by configuration. If the validation protocol is not configured (see EcuMValidationTimeout ), then a call to EcuM_SetWakeu- pEvent shall also imply a call to EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent .
